data.name: Anmika
data.gender_notes: Anmika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anmika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Anu’ meaning ‘towards’ and ‘Mika’ meaning ‘goddess’. This name signifies the graceful presence of a goddess moving towards someone. It is believed that this name was given to a goddess who came to the aid of a devotee in his time of need. The name Anmika carries the meaning “Graceful Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anmika usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anmika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anmika total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
